translations.1: And Bezalel and Oholiab and the rest of the skilled men, in whom God had placed wisdom and understanding — that they might know and perform all the craft of the work of the sanctuary, as God had commanded — were to do it.
translations.2: And Moses called out to them and to the rest of the skilled men in whom God had placed wisdom — every one who had seen fit in his own view to come forward to the craft to perform it.
translations.3: And they received from before Moses all the tribute which the sons of Israel had brought for the craft of the work of the sanctuary, to be made from it; and the people kept bringing freewill offerings every morning.
translations.4: Until all the skilled men — those performing all the craft of the sanctuary, each man in his craft which they were performing — came forward.
translations.5: And they said to Moses: 'Behold, the people are bringing more than enough for the craft of the work which God has commanded to be made.'
translations.6: And Moses commanded, and it was proclaimed by voice throughout the camp, saying: 'Let no man or woman bring anything further for the tribute of the sanctuary.' And so the people ceased from bringing anything.
translations.7: For what they had brought was sufficient for all the craft to be made from it — and there was surplus.
translations.8: And every skilled man among the craftsmen made the tabernacle itself: ten panels of fine linen twisted, with blue and purple and scarlet dye, fashioned with figures — the work of a skilled craftsman who made them.
translations.9: The length of each panel was twenty-eight cubits, and its width four cubits — one measure for all the panels.
translations.10: And he sewed every five panels, one with the other.
translations.11: And he made loops of blue upon the border of the one panel at the joining edge; and likewise he made at the edge of the border, at the outermost edge of the second joined panel.
translations.12: And he made fifty loops in the one panel, and fifty loops at the edge of the panel of the second joining; and he set the loops facing one another, one with the other.
translations.13: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and bound the panels one with the other by the clasps; and so the tabernacle became one.
translations.14: And he made panels of fine goat's wool — a tent over the tabernacle; eleven panels he made them.
translations.15: The length of each panel was thirty cubits, and its width four cubits — one measure for the eleven panels.
translations.16: And he sewed five panels by themselves and six panels by themselves.
translations.17: And he made fifty loops on the border of the outermost joining panel, and fifty loops on the border of the second joining panel.
translations.18: And he made fifty clasps of copper, to join the tent so that it should become one.
translations.19: And he made a covering for the tent of tanned ram skins, and a covering of fine leather above.
translations.20: And he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
translations.21: Ten cubits was the length of each board, and a cubit and a half its width.
translations.22: And it had two tongue-shaped pegs, one facing the other — so he made for all the boards of the tabernacle.
translations.23: And he made for the tabernacle twenty boards on the side toward the direction of the south wind.
translations.24: And he made forty silver bases under the twenty boards — two bases under each board for its two pegs.
translations.25: And for the second side of the tabernacle, on the side toward the direction of the north wind, he made twenty boards,
translations.26: with forty bases of silver for them — two bases under each board.
translations.27: And for the rear of the tabernacle toward the west, he made six boards.
translations.28: And two boards he made for the corners of the tabernacle at the two corners.
translations.29: And they were aligned from below, and together were aligned from above with one ring — so he made for both corners, for the two of them.
translations.30: And there came to be eight boards, and their bases of silver: sixteen bases, two bases under each board.
translations.31: And he made bars of acacia wood — five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
translations.32: and five bars for the boards of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle at its rear toward the west.
translations.33: And he made the middle bar to pass through the interior of the boards from end to end.
translations.34: And the boards he overlaid with gold; and he made their rings of gold as places for the bars; and he overlaid the bars with gold as well.
translations.35: And he made the veil of blue and purple and scarlet dye and fine linen twisted — the work of a skilled craftsman he made it, with figures.
translations.36: And he made for it four columns of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold; their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four bases of silver.
translations.37: And he made a curtain for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet dye and fine linen twisted — the work of an embroiderer.
translations.38: And its columns were five, with their hooks; and he overlaid their tops and coated them with gold; and their bases were five, of copper.
